Beats 360, the long-awaited and customizable new Beats headphones from Apple, just received their first major discount since they released back in September. For Black Friday weekend, you can score a pair for just $249, a $100 discount from their $349 launch price.

Beats 360 receive first major discount

I’ll save myself from reiterating my entire Beats 360 review, but if you’d like to read it, you can do so here.

In short, the Beats 360 are the closest you’ll get to AirPods Max without spending AirPods Max money, and unlike AirPods Max, they aren’t incredibly heavy and uncomfortable. For the first time with a pair of Beats (with custom Beats silicon), these support automatic device switching across your iCloud account.

The Beats 360 are also remarkably customizable, and you can swap out the ear cushions as you please. There’s a number of different color options to choose from, as well as two material choices: Performance Knit and UltraPlush. I highly recommend the UltraPlush.

Beats 360 also offer IPX4 sweat resistance unlike any previous Beats overears, as well as louder audio, excellent noise cancellation, and super clear transparency mode.

So, if you’re looking for a pair of headphones that deliver the Apple experience with easy pairing, Spatial Audio, automatic device switching, proper Find My integration, Siri support, and the whole nine yards – I’d highly recommend picking up a new pair of Beats 360 while they’re on sale.

The older Beats Studio Pro are also discounted to as low as $139.95 for Black Friday weekend if you’d like a more affordable pair of headphones. You can read my comparison here.

  • Buy Beats 360 on Amazon – $249.99 in Cloud and Black
  • Buy Beats Studio Pro on Amazon – $139.95 in select colorways, $149.00 in others
